_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
11AM: The Gondola is going on a wind hold. Updates to come!
9:15AM: Cub Carpet is on a mechanical hold. Updates to come!

12/18 - 6:25AM -  You may be able to cut your daily warm-up routine short this morning,as today's temperatures may help you do just that - warm up. For Thursday, we’ll see a high of 38°F in the base area and 35°F at the summit. To accompany these temperatures, you’ll be skiing and riding down 61 open trails spanning across 338 skiable acres. But you’re not the only one getting after it today, as our Grooming Team got after 46 trails last night, so take your pick and enjoy the corduroy. Chatting with one of our groomers early this morning, it’s a dreamy 33 degrees at Mid-Mountain already, and the snow is grooming out better than the winner of the Westminster Dog Show. Our favorite Lift Ops team will be out at 7 lifts to take you up the mountain starting at 9AM. Some delays may be possible due to high gusts today.

The trails in the Sun Bowl have little base and we feel it is best to close those trails for this week. We’ll keep everyone updated on the weekend’s plan as we keep an eye on the forecast.

Lodging deal Alert! Founders Lodge is now 40% off until December 22! So what are you waiting for BOOK NOW for your best winter trip yet!

Safety Tip: A great reminder to wear a helmet! According to the NSAA, “helmet usage has grown drastically over the last two decades. The overall percentage of skiers and riders wearing helmets increased from 25% in the 02/03 season to 90% in the 23/24 season”

Want to go on an adventure of a lifetime? Well, you're in luck, our Guided Snowmobile Tours are back! Explore Stratton after hours with friends and family on a tour to the summit. Be sure to book your spot now to guarantee it.

The Nordic Center is now open for Nordic Skiing and Snowshoeing! Enjoy the peaceful 10km of trails with friends or family.  

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability.
